title: `[http.client.tls]` is the operator's alone: the bundled roots unless files are named, TLS 1.2 unless the floor is raised, and no key log in `production`
divergesFromPhp: `curl.cainfo` and `openssl.cafile` are `ini` settings a script can widen with `ini_set`; here the three keys are `System` class and no code-side spelling for any of them exists
